description: Official technical lane plugin manifest (vendor-neutral, provider-instance-backed): the node reads its explicit providerInstanceRef, and the runtime provider layer resolves the instance and invokes the trusted registered technical adapter, which computes indicator features (EMA/RSI/ATR-style) over the market candles for the validated signal. The node contains no vendor logic; deterministic given the selected instance's inputs. DEM-PRODUCER-PLAN producer contract: when the canonical signal carries an afi.trade-plan.v1 plan, the lane verifies every submitted level against the fetched candle window (all levels within one observed-range width of the window; stop and targets on opposite sides of entry) and emits technical.plan; an unverifiable plan REFUSES the determination (D-DEM-5(6)). Declared absences (D-DEM-5(4)(b)): technical.plan is absent when the signal carries no plan; technical.plan.rrToFirstTarget is absent when the plan carries no stop or no target.

candleLimit.description: Number of candles fetched from the price feed for indicator computation.
